item.title: On My Understanding of Uncertainty
item.description: In my first week as a free agent, I truly felt the pressure of uncertainty, and it also made me more certain that this is my window. For me, stability does not equal safety. In a marginalized industrial environment, choosing certainty may actually make you lose competitiveness and optionality faster. I have also become increasingly convinced that uncertainty often contains huge opportunities, so I choose to embrace it.
